interaction_interpretation: Observed configuration interaction, not independent causal pass contributions.

measurement_definitions.text_bytes: Executable .text from size -A, includes startup code.
measurement_definitions.main_object_instruction_count: All objdump instruction lines in main.o, including alignment NOPs, same regex as baseline.
measurement_definitions.machine_basic_blocks_including_padding: Leaders: each disassembled function entry, in-function direct branch targets, instructions after branches/returns; includes alignment padding and is not LLVM/GIMPLE block count.
measurement_definitions.branches: j* and loop* instructions in main.o, excluding calls and returns.
measurement_definitions.final_ir_functions: LLVM optimized IR counts for Clang; optimized GNU GIMPLE counts for GCC, different representations.
